export_evidence: ImportKey page for THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (403-404, B Wing, Delphi, Hiranandani Business Park, Powai) reports 'Total Shipments 131193 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', but every visible row is an inbound record with India as DESTINATION, e.g. '2026-02-28 | FISHER SCIENTIFIC CO LLC | THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | PERCHLORIC ACID TRCE MTL 500ML | NEW YORK, Canada | HYDERABAD ACC INHYD4, India | 28111990 | BOL 7815894' and '2026-02-28 | THERMO ELECTRON LED GMBH | THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | HERASAFE 2030I 1.2 NSF 49 CONF | FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, GERMANY | HYDERABAD ACC INHYD4, India | 84146000 | BOL 7799729'. The page's own label is 'India Customs Import Records' / 'India import data refreshed daily'. No outbound (India-origin) shipment row with date, destination and B/L was seen. Source counter: page claims 131,193 total shipments; rows actually read = 5, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) on all attempts, and thecompanycheck.com, volza.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403. ImportKey does show Indian counterparties on the buyer side of inbound consignments (e.g. 'THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC (HONG KONG) LTD ... GE VERNOVA T&D INDIA LIMITED, BYD INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, JOHNSON & JOHNSON PRIVATE LIMITED'), which indicates domestic onward distribution, but this is a trading-partner listing, not a dated domestic supply record.
note: Large, active Indian subsidiary of Thermo Fisher Scientific (US). Customs footprint is confirmed and heavy, but it is IMPORT-side only: the company appears as consignee/buyer of lab reagents, instrument parts and equipment from Fisher Scientific Co LLC, Thermo Fisher Scientific (Hong Kong) Ltd, Thermo Electron LED GmbH, FEI Company of USA (S.E.A) Pte Ltd and Thermo Fisher Scientific Chemicals Inc. No export shipments from India were found in the free views checked, so export_status = none_found rather than confirmed. Declared HS 851779 (telecom/electronics) does not match the observed inbound HS codes (28111990 perchloric acid, 73181500 screws, 90129000 microscope parts, 84213990 filters, 84146000 biosafety cabinets) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to the observed instrument/reagent codes. Domestic supply: no dated GST, GeM/CPPP or contract evidence obtained — registries and catalogues are out of scope and the search engine was down, so this is recorded as unknown, not as confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the sources reachable). No CIN/PAN asserted — not verified from a primary registry.
